layout.title: Layout
layout.moveHint: Drag to move this card, or tap or press it for Move up and Move down buttons. Arrow Up and Arrow Down also move it.
layout.reset: Reset card order and expand all
layout.note.saved: Card order and collapsed cards are saved on this device.
layout.note.reset: Card order reset and every card expanded.
layout.note.session: Card order and collapsed cards last for this session only: settings cannot be saved here.
date.toolHint: Every result updates as you type. Calculate, Enter and Copy save to history.
date.card.between.sub: Counts the years, months and days between two dates, with totals in days, weeks, hours, minutes and seconds.
date.card.add.sub: Adds years, months, weeks and days to a date, or subtracts them. Month ends clamp (Jan 31 + 1 month = Feb 28/29).
date.card.business.sub: Counts working days between two dates, skipping the weekend and the holidays chosen in Settings. The earlier date is always counted.
date.card.age.sub: Exact age in years, months and days, with totals and the next birthday.
date.card.info.sub: Weekday, ISO week, day of the year, quarter, leap year and days left for any date.
date.card.countdown.sub: Live time left until a date (and optional time) on this device’s clock, or the time since it.
date.today.start: Set the start date to today
date.today.end: Set the end date to today
date.today.asOf: Set the as-of date to today
date.today.target: Set the target date to today
date.hint.add: date ± years, months (clamped to month end) → ± weeks, days = result
date.hint.business: calendar days − weekend days − holidays = business days
date.hint.age: birth + years → + months → + days = as of
date.hint.info: weekday · ISO week · day of year · quarter · days left
date.hint.countdown: target − now = days, hours, minutes, seconds
date.between.weekdaysBackward: {start} → {end} (the end date is before the start date)
date.mode.label: Add or subtract
date.add.businessNote: Years and months step on the calendar first; then weeks count as business weeks (weeks × working days per week), then business days.
date.add.clamped: The day was moved to the last day of the month.
date.warn.presetYears: Part of this range is outside the holiday preset’s years (presets cover at most 1900–2199), so only the weekend is skipped there.
date.warn.estimated: Includes estimated Islamic holiday dates (they can differ by 1–2 days).
date.biz.backward: end date is before the start date
date.info.daysLeftValue: {year} in the year · {month} in the month
date.cal.hintStart: Next click sets the start date.
date.cal.hintEnd: Next click sets the end date.
date.cd.label: Label (optional)
date.cd.idle: Pick a target date to start the countdown.
date.cd.finished: Finished: {when} has passed. Counting the time since.
date.cd.finishedClosed: Finished while the app was closed: {when}. Counting the time since.
date.cd.note.saved: Saved on this device. It resumes when you reopen the app.
date.cd.note.session: Kept for this session only: this browser mode is not saving data.
date.cd.note.newer: The saved countdowns are from a newer version, so they are left untouched.
date.cd.note.unreadable: The saved countdowns could not be read, so they are left untouched.
date.cd.note.writeFailed: The countdown could not be saved on this device.
date.cd.note.full: At most {max} countdowns. Delete one to add another.
date.cd.paneEmpty: No countdowns yet. Add one on the Countdown card of the Date tool.
date.set.firstDay: First day of the week (mini calendars)
date.set.weekendAll: The weekend cannot cover all seven days.
date.set.egyptNote: Egypt’s weekend is Fri/Sat, so choosing Egypt switches the weekend to Fri/Sat. You can change it back above.
date.set.hijriNote: Islamic holidays are estimated from the tabular Hijri calendar and can differ from the announced dates by 1–2 days. Shift them by −2 to +2 days, or set the announced date for a single year in the list below.
date.set.hijriNoYear: This date could not be matched to an Islamic year.
date.set.previewLabel: Preset holidays for the selected year
date.set.outOfRange: The {preset} preset has no holidays for {year}; only the weekend counts in that year.
date.set.outOfRangeCovers: The {preset} preset has no holidays for {year} (it covers {first}–{last}); only the weekend counts in that year.
date.set.customNoName: Enter a name for the holiday.
date.set.customNoDate: Pick a date for the holiday.
date.set.customFull: At most {max} custom holidays are allowed.
date.set.saveFailed: The setting could not be saved.
rescue.unsupported.title: Unsupported browser
rescue.unsupported.body: This browser cannot run the calculator engine (WebAssembly). Use Safari or iOS 16.4+, Chrome or Edge 97+, or Firefox 102+. On iPhone and iPad, Lockdown Mode turns WebAssembly off.
rescue.integrity.title: The engine file is damaged
rescue.integrity.body: The calculator engine did not match its checksum, so it was not started. Reload the page; if this keeps happening, the download was changed on the way.
rescue.load-failed.title: The engine could not be loaded
rescue.load-failed.body: The calculator engine file could not be downloaded. Check the connection and reload the page.
rescue.heading: Your saved data
rescue.readOnly: This view only reads. It never changes or deletes anything stored on this device.
rescue.blocked: This browser does not allow reading the stored data.
rescue.empty: Nothing from this app is stored on this device.

rescue.count.one: {count} stored item, shown exactly as saved:
rescue.count.other: {count} stored items, shown exactly as saved:

rescue.copyFailed: Copying is not allowed here. Use Save instead.
rescue.saveFailed: Saving is not allowed here. Use Copy instead.
rescue.oldApps: The older Date Calculator and Percentage Calculator web apps do not need WebAssembly and still work in this browser.

percent.toolHint: Every result updates as you type. Calculate, Enter and Copy save to history.
percent.card.change.sub: Shows how much a value increased or decreased relative to the original.
percent.card.percent.sub: Finds what percentage one number is of another.
percent.card.what.sub: Calculates a percentage portion of a number.
percent.card.discount.sub: Calculates final price and savings after a percentage discount.
percent.card.base.sub: Finds the full number when you know a value and its percentage.
percent.card.markup.sub: Calculates net profit, markup % on cost, and gross margin % on selling price.
percent.card.tax.sub: Adds a percentage tax/VAT to a net amount or extracts tax from a tax-inclusive total.
percent.card.tip.sub: Add a tip and split the total bill evenly between people.
percent.swap.title.tip: Swap bill amount and tip percentage
percent.formula.label: {title}: live formula
percent.error.people: People must be a whole number (1 or more)
percent.note.people: (People must be a whole number (1 or more))
